sections.title: The pure-state postulate and physical equivalence
sections.question: Which normalized vectors describe the same pure qubit state, and what can one computational-basis probability pair establish?
sections.entry: Exact prerequisite2.2: complex inner products, normalization and Cauchy–Schwarz equality; computational-basis ket notation and physical postulates introduced locally.
sections.exit: State pure-state and fixed-basis Born postulates; derive probability normalization and global-phase invariance; compare vectors with phase alignment without equating one probability pair with a state.
sections.worked_case: Normalized(1,i)/sqrt2, its global-i multiple and(1,-i)/sqrt2; same fixed-basis probabilities, only the global multiple is equivalent. Released FlagQuantum H/Z states provide a separate real-amplitude case.
sections.boundary: P depth: physical postulates stated, algebraic consequences derived. No general measurement operators, update rules, mixtures, gates theorem or extra numbered prerequisite.
sections.code_plan: CPU complex128 released FlagQuantum0.3.1 H and H/Z outputs; explicit scalar-complex reference, global phase applied only to simulator arrays, overlap alignment, strict unit-vector domain and probability checks.
sections.independent_check: Hand complex amplitudes, overlap values, raw/aligned distances; exact Cauchy–Schwarz criterion; unequal probabilities, zero/unnormalized/nonfinite/shape/dtype rejection and orthogonal overlap boundary.
sections.transfer_task: Distinguish normalization from physical preparation, repair phase-alignment conjugation, refute probability-only equivalence, analyze basis-state phase; full answers.
sections.next_transition: Sections3.1–3.5 have working drafts; next production assignment3.6. Independent acceptance pending.

sections.entry: Canonical3.1 pure-state/Born postulates and2.3 linear maps/basis coordinates; H and diagonal phase maps defined locally as ideal experiment assumptions, without importing3.4 evolution theory.
sections.exit: Fully derive the complex interference cross term, balanced and unbalanced fringes, and dependence on a chosen analyzer phase; distinguish passive coordinates from active operations.
sections.worked_case: D(phi)H|0>, implemented H then phase then optional phase(-delta) then H; phases0,pi/2,pi,3pi/2,2pi and +/-i pair with delta=pi/2.
sections.boundary: F depth full probability expansion. No general measurement/update rule, noise-channel model, Bloch geometry, generator theory or tomography claim.
sections.code_plan: Released FlagQuantum0.3.1 CPU complex128 circuits compared with independent scalar-complex matrices, analytic fringes and direct probabilities; no hardware or shots.
sections.independent_check: 17-point phase sweep, five displayed cases, +/-i analyzer witness, common-phase invariance, unbalanced3/5,4/5 amplitudes, zero-amplitude and probability-only counterexamples.
sections.transfer_task: Compute unbalanced fringe and contrast; diagnose missing conjugate and operation order; choose analysis phase and explain fixed-setting ambiguity; full answers.

sections.title: The Bloch-sphere representation

sections.entry: Exact3.1 pure-state/Born postulates and2.3 maps/basis coordinates. Pauli matrices, spherical-angle conventions and local quadratic forms introduced here;3.2 not required.
sections.exit: Prove half-angle representative, explicit Pauli quadratic coordinates, unit-sphere identity and inverse/ray uniqueness; diagnose pole ambiguity and Y-sign mistakes.
sections.worked_case: Six cardinal rays plus alpha=sqrt3/2,beta=i/2 with point(0,sqrt3/2,1/2); phase-equivalent inverse representatives, positive-y sign and orthogonal antipodes.
sections.boundary: F depth; pure-state geometry in fixed computational basis. Pauli products/generators in3.5; operational expectation values in6.3; mixed-state ball in Chapter8.
sections.code_plan: Torch complex128 explicit quadratic forms versus independent scalar coordinates on a spherical grid; stable two-chart inversion, released FlagQuantum0.3.1 cardinal/equatorial circuit states. Original static scientific sphere figure.
sections.independent_check: Six hand coordinate triples,169 angle pairs including poles, nontrivial global phase, inverse overlap, orthogonal partner and wrong Y sign; invalid state/sphere domains; near-pole reconstruction.
sections.transfer_task: Compute a non-cardinal point and computational probabilities, explain half angles/antipodes and pole ambiguity, repair a Y transpose bug, reject origin as a pure state; full answers.

sections.entry: Exact3.1 pure-state postulates and2.6 Hermitian exponentials/derivatives; matrix product rule and time/energy units stated locally.
sections.exit: Adopt unitary evolution; derive H=i*hbar*dotU*Udagger and its Hermiticity, state equation and constant-H solution; explain endpoint nonuniqueness and time-dependent limits.

sections.boundary: P depth: no derivation of the physical postulate from norm preservation, no time-dependent exponential substitution, no general rotation algebra or calibrated device Hamiltonian claim.
